topic: Skin structure, functions, disorders, and diseases
author: codex-authoring-run-2026-08-13-skin-01

why: Sweat glands in the skin release perspiration. Perspiration carries water, salt, and small amounts of waste out of the body.
皮肤里的汗腺会排出汗液。汗液把水、盐和少量废物带出身体。
lock: skin removes some waste through sweat.
皮肤通过汗液排出少量废物。

why: Sebum is skin oil that helps keep skin soft. Sweat adds water; together they form a thin protective surface layer.
sebum（皮脂）是帮助皮肤保持柔软的油脂。汗液提供水分，两者共同形成薄薄的表面保护层。
lock: sebum adds oil; sweat adds water.
皮脂提供油分；汗液提供水分。

why: The epidermis is the skin's outer layer. Its surface is made of dead cells that are continually shed and replaced.
epidermis（表皮）是皮肤最外层。它的表面由不断脱落并被替换的死细胞组成。
lock: epidermis = outer skin layer.
epidermis = 皮肤外层。

why: Exfoliation removes dead cells from the skin surface. Removing this rough outer buildup makes the skin feel smoother.
exfoliation（去角质）能去掉皮肤表面的死细胞。除去粗糙的表层堆积后，皮肤会更光滑。
lock: exfoliate = remove dead surface cells.
exfoliate = 去除表面死细胞。

why: The epidermis is above the dermis and the deeper fatty layer. It is the part of the skin that faces the outside world.
epidermis（表皮）位于真皮和更深的脂肪层上方，是皮肤接触外界的部分。
lock: outermost skin = epidermis.
最外层皮肤 = 表皮。

why: Skin condition affects which products and services are safe. Knowing what healthy skin needs helps a technician avoid irritation and injury.
皮肤状况会影响哪些产品和服务是安全的。了解健康皮肤的基本需要，可帮助美甲师避免刺激和损伤。
lock: know skin needs before choosing a service.
选择服务前先了解皮肤需要。
refs: Skin Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Skin Health

why: The epidermis forms the body's outside covering. It protects the living tissue below from water loss, injury, and germs.
epidermis（表皮）形成身体外层，保护下面的活组织，减少水分流失、损伤和细菌进入。
lock: epidermis = protective outer layer.
epidermis = 保护性外层。

why: Healthy skin can bend and stretch with body movement. Rigid means stiff and unable to bend easily, so it is not a healthy quality.
健康皮肤能随着身体动作弯曲和伸展。rigid 表示僵硬、不易弯曲，因此不是健康皮肤的特点。
lock: healthy skin = flexible, not rigid.
健康皮肤 = 柔韧，不僵硬。
refs: Skin Structure - Characteristics of Healthy Skin

why: Sensitization develops after repeated contact with a product. Later, even a small amount can cause a strong allergic reaction.
sensitization（致敏）可能在反复接触产品后形成。之后即使少量接触，也可能引起强烈过敏反应。
lock: repeated contact can lead to sensitization.
反复接触可能导致致敏。

why: Skin cells need oxygen and nutrients to stay alive and repair damage. Blood carries both to the skin.
皮肤细胞需要氧气和营养物质来生存并修复损伤。血液把这两样带到皮肤。
lock: blood carries oxygen plus nutrients to skin.
血液把氧气和营养物质带到皮肤。

why: The stratum lucidum is a clear layer of the epidermis. It is found in thick skin such as the palms and soles.
stratum lucidum（透明层）是表皮中的透明层，存在于手掌和脚底等较厚的皮肤中。
lock: stratum lucidum = clear layer in thick skin.
stratum lucidum = 厚皮肤中的透明层。

why: Sebaceous glands make skin oil and usually open into hair follicles. The palms have no hair follicles, so they have no sebaceous glands.
皮脂腺制造皮脂，通常开口于毛囊。手掌没有毛囊，因此也没有皮脂腺。
lock: palms: no hair follicles, no sebaceous glands.
手掌：没有毛囊，也没有皮脂腺。

why: Skin forms a physical covering around the body. This layer helps block injury, germs, and excessive water loss.
皮肤在身体外形成保护层，帮助阻挡损伤和细菌，并防止水分过度流失。
lock: main skin role = protection.
皮肤主要作用 = 保护。

why: An ulcer is an open sore where skin or a moist body lining has been lost. Open skin can let germs enter.
ulcer（溃疡）是皮肤或湿润黏膜缺损形成的开放性伤口。皮肤破开后，细菌可能进入。
lock: ulcer = open sore.
ulcer = 开放性溃疡。

why: A fissure is a deep crack that reaches the dermis. Because the skin is split open, it can hurt and let germs enter.
fissure（皮肤裂隙）是深达真皮的裂口。皮肤裂开后可能疼痛，也可能让细菌进入。
lock: fissure = deep open skin crack.
fissure = 深而开放的皮肤裂口。

why: In the ABCDE warning check, B means border. A mole with an uneven or unclear border should be checked by a doctor.
在 ABCDE 警示检查中，B 代表 border（边界）。边界不规则或不清楚的痣应由医生检查。
lock: ABCDE: B = border irregularity.
ABCDE：B = 边界不规则。

why: A mole is a colored spot formed by groups of pigment-making cells. A change in its shape, color, or size needs medical attention.
mole（痣）是色素细胞聚集形成的有色斑点。形状、颜色或大小发生变化时需要就医检查。
lock: changing mole = refer for medical examination.
痣发生变化 = 建议就医检查。

why: Melanoma is a dangerous cancer of pigment-making skin cells. Early medical treatment matters because it can spread through the body.
melanoma（黑色素瘤）是色素细胞发生的危险皮肤癌。它可能扩散到全身，因此早期就医很重要。
lock: melanoma = dangerous skin cancer.
melanoma = 危险的皮肤癌。

why: Cellulitis is a bacterial infection in deeper skin tissue. It needs medical care, but ordinary person-to-person contact does not spread it easily.
cellulitis（蜂窝织炎）是较深皮肤组织的细菌感染，需要医疗处理，但一般接触不容易在人与人之间传播。
lock: cellulitis = serious infection, not highly contagious.
cellulitis = 严重感染，但不是高度传染。

notes: All candidates remain unreviewed. Two source items were quarantined because their keyed claims are not supported as unique textbook facts.
